name: Investments
overview: Scripture encourages wise and generous stewardship of resources, as seen in Ecclesiastes 11:1 where believers are urged to 'cast thy bread upon the waters,' trusting that their investments will yield returns over time. Matthew 25:27 further emphasizes the responsibility to actively manage what God entrusts, suggesting that money should be put to work to gain increase. Additionally, Acts 20:35 reminds Christians that the ultimate blessing comes not from accumulating wealth, but from giving and supporting others, reflecting the heart of Christ's teaching on generosity.
